--- /workspace/embed_bug.py
+++ /workspace/embed_bug.py
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+embed_bug.py
@@ -1,0 +5,103 @@
+Embed a text payload into a JPEG's EXIF UserComment field.
+
+Usage:
+  python3 embed_bug.py input.jpg "some text" [-o output.jpg]
+  python3 embed_bug.py input.jpg --payload-file info.txt -o out.jpg
+
+This script uses piexif and Pillow. Install with:
+  pip3 install piexif Pillow
+"""
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+
+try:
+    import piexif
+    from piexif import ExifIFD
+    from piexif.helper import UserComment
+    from PIL import Image
+except Exception as e:
+    sys.exit("Missing dependency: please install required packages with\n  pip3 install piexif Pillow\n\nError: " + str(e))
+
+
+def load_payload(args):
+    if args.payload_file:
+        with open(args.payload_file, "rb") as f:
+            return f.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+    if args.payload is not None:
+        return args.payload
+    raise ValueError("No payload provided.")
+
+
+def ensure_exif_dict(exif_dict):
+    # piexif.load may return an empty dict for files without EXIF
+    if not isinstance(exif_dict, dict) or not exif_dict:
+        return {"0th": {}, "Exif": {}, "GPS": {}, "1st": {}, "thumbnail": None}
+    # ensure required sections exist
+    for key in ("0th", "Exif", "GPS", "1st", "thumbnail"):
+        if key not in exif_dict:
+            exif_dict[key] = {} if key != "thumbnail" else None
+    return exif_dict
+
+
+def embed_user_comment(input_path, payload_text, output_path=None, encoding="unicode"):
+    if output_path is None:
+        output_path = input_path
+
+    # Load existing EXIF (if any)
+    try:
+        exif_dict = piexif.load(input_path)
+    except Exception:
+        exif_dict = {"0th": {}, "Exif": {}, "GPS": {}, "1st": {}, "thumbnail": None}
+
+    exif_dict = ensure_exif_dict(exif_dict)
+
+    # Create UserComment bytes using helper (adds charset header)
+    comment_bytes = UserComment.dump(payload_text, encoding=encoding)
+
+    # Set the UserComment tag (ExifIFD.UserComment == 37510)
+    exif_dict["Exif"][ExifIFD.UserComment] = comment_bytes
+
+    # Dump back to bytes
+    exif_bytes = piexif.dump(exif_dict)
+
+    # Save image with new EXIF
+    img = Image.open(input_path)
+    # Ensure output directory exists
+    outdir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(output_path))
+    if outdir and not os.path.exists(outdir):
+        os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+
+    img.save(output_path, "jpeg", exif=exif_bytes)
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Embed a text payload into a JPEG's EXIF UserComment field.")
+    p.add_argument("input", help="Input JPEG file path")
+    p.add_argument("payload", nargs="?", help="Payload text to embed (mutually exclusive with --payload-file)")
+    p.add_argument("--payload-file", "-f", help="Read payload text from a file (UTF-8).")
+    p.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output JPEG path. If omitted, input file will be overwritten.", default=None)
+    args = p.parse_args()
+
+    if not os.path.isfile(args.input):
+        sys.exit(f"Input file not found: {args.input}")
+
+    if args.payload and args.payload_file:
+        sys.exit("Specify either payload positional argument or --payload-file, not both.")
+
+    try:
+        payload_text = load_payload(args)
+    except Exception as e:
+        sys.exit("Failed to read payload: " + str(e))
+
+    try:
+        embed_user_comment(args.input, payload_text, args.output)
+    except Exception as e:
+        sys.exit("Failed to embed payload: " + str(e))
+
+    outpath = args.output if args.output else args.input
+    print(f"Embedded payload into UserComment and wrote output to: {outpath}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
